jobs_results.title: Data Engineer especializado en Gobernanza de Datos
jobs_results.description:
Desde Grupo NS necesitamos incorporar un Ingeniero de Datos especializado en gobernanza técnica del dato para un proyecto en modalidad Híbrida (MADRID)

Es esencial tener experiencia comprobada en ingeniería de datos y llamadas a APIs (mínimo 2 años), así como un conocimiento profundo de herramientas de gobernanza de datos.

La experiencia en el stack AWS, especialmente en AWS Glue, Glue Data Quality, Lake Formation y Data Zone (Mínimo 3 años a excepción de Data Zone), es muy deseable.

Además, se valora la experiencia con otros hiperescalares y soluciones como Purview, Collibra, Informática o Anjana (mínimo 2 años).

Requisitos mínimos
• Al menos tres años de experiencia como Ingenerio de Datos especializado en gobernanza del dato
• Experiencia de al menos tres años en AWS
• Residir en Madrid ya que la modalidad es 100% teletrabajo

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs_results.description:
At Schwarz Global Services – Barcelona, we offer high value IT services for the entire Schwarz Group, which includes Lidl, Kaufland, Schwarz Produktion, PreZero, STACKIT and XMCyber. We are in the worldwide top 5 of Retail companies with 13.700 stores spread in 33 countries, more than 6 billion costumers, and over 575.000 employees. We strive to develop and implement smart and efficient IT solutions to deliver the best experience to our users, customers, and colleagues. We are looking for open-minded colleagues with passion for technology, who are willing to find diverse and exciting career opportunities in a dynamic work environment that stands for development and progress.

What You'll Do
• As a Data Engineer, you will contribute to bring data analytics to production at scale in LIDL. Taking part on data teams building data platforms or data products together with data science and data management teams.
• Build and maintain scalable data pipelines (batch and real time) from... different sources to insert high volumes of data in our lake and make data available for our stakeholders.
• Collaborate with other data team members in Data management and Data platform in order to implement and improve our data solutions.
• Data modelling: model our datasets to ease data consumptions for our stakeholders

What You'll Need
• Languages: Scala/Python and SQL
• Big Data Frameworks: Databricks, Spark
• Data Base: relational (SQL Server)
• CI/CD flows & tools: Azure DevOps
• Monitoring and alerting tools: Azure Monitoring, Grafana
• MS’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
• 4+ years’ experience in software development
• 2+ years’ experience in Big Data Frameworks
• Experience in Agile methodology
• Experience with data workflow management tools like Airflow
• Experience in Cloud platforms, specially Microsoft Azure.
• As a bonus, contribution to open-source projects.

Nice to have
• Passion for learning new tools, languages and frameworks
• Ability to be creative and innovation-minded, self-motivated and proactive.
• Fast adaptation to changing requirements and strong problem-solving skills.
• To work in a collaborative model, side by side with the business.
• The position requires fluency in English and effective collaboration in English-speaking teams.

What We Offer
• You will be part of an international team composed by people from different countries and backgrounds, where you’ll be able to share your experience and knowledge to carry-out team work and meet the objectives.
• On top of this, you’ll have a personal follow-up with your management team to help you understanding all business-related questions and guide you in your professional career.
• We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package: lunch vouchers, health and dental insurance, transport, wellbeing, etc.

We look forward to receiving your application.

Schwarz Global Services
• Laura Hernandez Costa
• Reference no. 42146 C/Bergara 13, floor 5, 08002 Barcelona es.it.schwarz

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer Intern
jobs_results.description:
Data Engineer Intern

Eurovision Services is looking for a Data Engineer Intern based in Madrid, Spain.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES OF THIS POSITION

In this role as Data Engineer Intern, you will:
• Support on the design and implement data warehousing solutions using star schema / snowflake model.
• Support in the develop and maintenance of data pipelines using Azure Data Factory
• Support in the develop and maintenance of reports using Power BI, SSRS, and SSAS
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and implement data-driven solutions.
• Collaborate in the administration of database, especially for Oracle and MySQL DBs

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
• The successful candidate must have:
• Possibility to sign an internship agreement with your university or business school.
• Availability to work full time.
• Proficiency in English is a must.
• Passion for learning, adaptability to change and grow.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field... Master’s degree is a plus.
• Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and methodologies is a plus.

BENEFITS AND PERKS
• Hybrid modality: 2 days in the office and 3 days remote.
• Full-time job with flexible starting hour.
• Remuneration of 900€ monthly
• Ticket restaurant:11€ per working day

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer
jobs_results.description:
DATAIS, a consultancy specializing in the design and execution of data and artificial intelligence projects, adopts an integrated approach to cover the entire data cycle and strategy. As a network of expert professionals, DATAIS fosters trust and collaborates to provide data and IA solutions, and tailored support services, including training and consulting.

Born as a Spin-off of VISUALITICS focused on data analysis and visualization expertise, our projects have expanded to engage with diverse aspects of the data landscape.

We want to empower our clients with a competitive advantage by unlocking true value and creating meaningful, actionable and timely business insights with our ability to use state-of-the-art technologies and algorithms. We develop the strategic, technical, and human capabilities that take companies from vision to value and create truly data-driven organizations.

We are now looking for Data Engineers (3+ years of experience) to join our team based in Madrid. Would... you like to work in a young and friendly environment? If you love technology, challenges and willing to contribute to our mission…then you could be the person we are looking for!

Tareas

As a Data Engineer you will:
• Design and implementation of solutions processing large and unstructured datasets (Data Lake Architecture, Streaming Architecture)
• Design, build and maintain big data architecture and data pipeline
• Develop and implement CI/CD pipeline automation solutions.
• Implementation, optimization and testing of modern DWH/Big Data solutions based on Azure cloud, GCP or AWS platform and Continuous Delivery / Continuous Integration environment
• Data processing efficiency improvement, migrations from on-prem to public cloud platforms.
• Build relationships with client stakeholders to establish a high level of rapport and confidence
• Work with clients and teams to deliver modern data products
• You are a very creative person, who drives to build your own prototype solutions and provides training and guidance to team members and partners.

Requisitos

Qualifications & Compentences:

3+ years of experience in Data Engineering field
• Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or other scientific fields
• Data Enthusiast: Driven by a passion for data and technology.
• ETL Maestro: Skilled in orchestrating ETL processes with precision and finesse.
• Spark Wizard: Adept at conjuring data cleaning and transformation magic in a Spark/Scala environment using Python.
• SQL Sage: Master of SQL and the Apache Spark realm.
• OLAP Explorer: Navigates OLAP architectures with ease.
• Cloud Commander: Technically savvy in architecting and managing cloud-based solutions.
• DevOps and Kubernetes explorer: Loves working collaboratively and follows best practices in Git and DevOps and best practices Steers the ship of Kubernetes even if you're just starting out.
• Data Alchemist: Comfortable with schema-on-read databases like Redis.
• Meticulous Organizer: Possesses an eye for detail and organizational finesse.
• Independent Trailblazer: Thrives when working proactively and autonomously.
• Problem-Solving Maestro: Solves challenges through information gathering, thoughtful evaluation, and ingenious solutions.
• Greate communicator, both verbal and written
• Pressure Player: Thrives under pressure, even within complex organizational landscapes.
• English Pro: Proficiency in English is non-negotiable.r data and technology

Beneficios

What do we offer:
• Competitive salary
• Semi-annual bonus on target achievement
• Flexible Benefits
• Remote or Hybrid work
• Flexible working hours
• Wellness days
• Friendly and challenging working environment
• Lifelong learning mindset with budget for certifications, training and personal development
• Be protagonist of disruptive tech events in collaboration with several tech communities, scaleups, Universities and Bootcamps

Become a part of our community on LinkedIn to discover more about our activities and stay updated on all the latest news in machine learning, big data, and AI. Join Datais People on meetup .com/es-ES/datais/ to receive updates on our upcoming events

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer Trainee
jobs_results.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Data Engineer Trainee in Madrid, who is willing to join a fresh, agile, entrepreneur environment. The ideal candidate would be pursuing a Computer Science Degree or training in Data Engineering tasks. Recently graduated applicants would also be considered.

The candidate should have problem-solving mindset, with a strong hands-on attitude who is looking to execute day to day tasks to support the different clients and project.

The candidate would like to work in an exciting and flexible environment, focusing on performance, using the latest technologies. This role is based in Madrid.

What you will do

Support the Data Engineering team to complete the migration of existing data pipelines due to a change in data model and format for a large number of datasets.
• ETL configurations in order to ingest new DDM datasets into our platform
• root cause for ETL issues and apply appropriate corrections
• quality control
• to improve technical... documentation
• implement and maintain data integration code based on Python and PySpark where required.
• a wide range of data-driven projects working on assigned projects to meet client project requirements and deadlines.

Your qualifications

The following software engineering familiarizations are desirable
• Technologies: JSON, Python.
• Architecture: Cloud (MS Azure preferred), Azure Data Factory and Databricks.
• Platforms: Understanding the Azure service catalog
• Databases: Knowledge with SQL Server, PostgreSQL and/or Snowflake is a plus.
• Others: Interest in Business Intelligence and Process Improvements.

Ideal soft skills:
• passionate, intellectual curiosity, self-starter, embracing continuous improvement, execution-oriented, change driver.
• spirit, quick learner, flexible and ability to adapt to change.
• player, highly qualified to build internal and external relationships.
• high self-motivation and ambition.
• orientated, competitive and comfortable in challenging situations
• communication and interpersonal skills
• is our working language. Spanish, French or Portuguese would be an advantage.

Life at Redslim
• work environment within a cohesive and collaborative team
• package commensurate with experience (including substantial performance bonus)
• All Staff gathering week, office parties, team offsite
• What’s Next

Redslim is constantly seeking new talents. You may already have the right skills we look for, come join us! We believe that people from different backgrounds and experiences can bring fresh ideas, thinking, and approaches that translate into effective and efficient ways of working. You're welcome at Redslim whatever your background is.

If you think this position is for you, please click the Apply Now button!

Redslim is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Redslim. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias

¿Eres únic@?

Entonces eres KPMG Originals. Un modo de entender la vida y tu profesión diferente desde donde marcar la diferencia. Un modo de crecer en un ambiente profesional que busca cambiar las cosas, transformar las empresas y la sociedad.

Ven, alcanza tus metas, supera tus límites en un ambiente profesional único y únete a una firma que es más que una firma de Servicios Profesionales. Sé KPMG Originals.

Desde el equipo de LIGHTHOUSE, nuestra área de Data & Analytics, ayudamos a nuestros clientes a encontrar la eficiencia y el alto rendimiento en todas sus funciones TIC, tanto internas como externas hacia sus unidades de negocio y proveedores: buscando la máxima eficiencia en la operación de sus servicios y ajustando sus costes; así como incrementando su trascendencia en la cuenta de resultados y facilitando la innovación.

Actualmente, nos encontramos en proceso de crecimiento y estamos buscando un Cloud Data Engineer para incorporarse al equipo.

¿Qué necesitas saber?
• Grado... en Informática, telecomunicaciones o ramas afines.
• Más de 3 años de experiencia en proyectos/desarrollos Data Analytics y/o analítica Avanzada.
• Solidos principios y conceptos de la computación en la nube.
• Capacidad para realizar diseño de arquitectura para soluciones de Data Analytics.
• Imprescindible experiencia demostrable en definición y desarrollo de soluciones en torno al dato en ecosistemas Cloud (preferentemente Azure: Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Azure ML, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Databricks, Azure Notebooks…).
• Experiencia en gestión y modelado de Base de datos.
• Programación en Python y/o Scala.

Se valorará:
• Formaciones y certificaciones en desarrollos en nube publica (preferentemente Azure) en el ámbito de Data Analytics, por ejemplo: Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900), Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900), Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) o similares.
• Conocimientos básicos de redes y seguridad en cloud.

¿Qué valor añadido te podemos aportar?
• Un gran ambiente de trabajo, tanto dentro como fuera de la oficina
• Oportunidades internacionales y red de contactos global
• Formacióncontinuay plan de carrera a tu medida
• Salario competitivo y plan de remuneración flexible
• 31 días laborables de vacaciones
• La tarde de tu cumpleaños libre
• Flexibilidad y posibilidad de teletrabajo
• Acceso a Kteam, nuestra plataforma de bienestar, servicios, solidaridad y promociones
• Los beneficios pueden variar para programas de becas y/o prácticas

Nuestro compromiso en KPMG es promover ambientes de trabajo en los que se trate con respeto y dignidad a las personas, garantizando la igualdad de oportunidades en su selección, formación y promoción ofreciendo un entorno de trabajo libre de cualquier discriminación por motivo de género, edad, discapacidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, religión, etnia, estado civil o cualquier otra circunstancia personal o social. Y es que cada persona tiene un valor único y especial que aportar a la firma.

- Asimismo, es el... responsable del mantenimiento y evolución de la plataforma de Venta- CRM desde el punto de vista técnico, de modelo de datos y de flujos de información.

- Es el responsable del planteamiento, diseño funcional, implementación y puesta en marcha de la herramienta de Marketing Automation y también se encargará de la operativa de campañas, programación de creatividades y datos.

jobs_results.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Be extraordinary - Excite the ordinary!

Our vision is to make a healthy and sustainable lifestyle the most attractive choice. So we defy: the status quo, misleading product, and nonsense rules! We truly believe in the power of ideas and are thirsty to realize the ones that could have impact. We're an eclectic bunch of creative minds, experts, builders, and improvers. Our perspectives, cultures, backgrounds, dreams, skills, and life paths may have nothing in common, but we gather behind a vision and sail together towards our ambitious goals.

Are you looking to take on a new challenge? Let's talk.

The Team and Role

At air up, data has always been at the core of our strategic vision. As we enter our next phase of rapid growth, the role of data is more vital than ever in further growing and scaling our business.

As Staff Data Engineer, you will join our growing data and engineering organization to own and lead the data engineering domain. You will play a pivotal role in building and... shaping the function, including architecture, technology, ways of working and more.

You will work closely with other technical teams and leads to enable data-driven decision-making and achieve common objectives.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the entire data engineering area and have significant organizational impact but also comes with plenty of challenges and high expectations. Striking the right balance between long-term strategy and short-term deliverables will be crucial for success.

Your responsibilities

In a nutshell, you are expected to own and evolve our data platform to enable data-driven decision-making, foster innovation, drive growth and ultimately contribute to air up's success.
• Design and Build: Design, build and evolve robust platforms and systems to support air up's evolving needs for analytics and decision intelligence.
• Ingest and Integrate: Ensure consistent data integration and flow across various systems, enhancing the quality and accessibility of data.
• Drive Technical Excellence: Implement best practices, DataOps, observability, etc. to maximize technological leverage and ensure data accuracy and accessibility, safeguarding the integrity of our data assets.
• Lead and Collaborate: Be the technical leader for your area. Work closely with and mentor other data engineers. Collaborate across teams and functions to understand data needs and provide innovative and effective solutions.

That's you
• You hold a degree in Computer Science or a closely related field, equipping you with a solid foundation in analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
• You have at least 10 years of hands-on experience as a software or data engineer, with at least 3 years in technical leadership roles (Lead/Staff Engineer or similar). Ideally, you’ve spent a significant portion of your career being part of high-performing software engineering teams.
• You are proficient in one or more programming languages and have strong knowledge of modern data architectures, platforms, technologies, and paradigms, including strong expertise with cloud services like AWS or GCP and their data-related offerings.
• You are deeply experienced in designing, building and maintaining scalable and reliable data pipelines, platforms, and infrastructure.
• You are a strong advocate for agile and lean methodologies as well as DevOps and engineering best practices, understanding that they accelerate learning, delivery and drive success.
• You are a strong problem solver, who thrives in ambiguity and dynamic, fast-paced environments.
• You are not only exceptional at your work, but also humble, open-minded, and a pleasure to work with and be around. 🤗

Our Data Tech Stack

AWS (incl. Redshift, Glue, etc.), Terraform, Airflow, dbt, fivetran, Veezoo, Tableau, etc.

But what’s in for you?

🏖 30 days of vacation

🏷 discount on our products

💰 employer-funded pension & location related insurances

📈 personal development

🏁 start-up spirit

🌍 workation

_________________________________________________________________________________

air up® have developed an innovative and world-first drinking system. Through scent alone, the air up® bottle brings flavour to simple tap water and can be enjoyed without any single-use plastic bottles, sugar, or additives. air up is a young, fast-growing company filled with ambitious and creative minds from various backgrounds.

air up® is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining an equal opportunity environment for all persons free of discriminatory behaviour. We will not discriminate and will take affirmative action measures to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, upgrading, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the bases of race, color, gender, national origin, age, religion, creed, disability, veteran's status, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression
